title: Siege of Rouen (1418–1419)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Rouen (1418–1419)", at revision 1370744848, opens: "The siege of Rouen was a major event in the Hundred Years' War, in which English forces loyal to Henry V captured Rouen, the capital of Normandy, from the Norman French." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q815203, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1418 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
